title: NOVA
summary: This portfolio's own cinematic AI operating environment — the system you are using right now.
description: An immersive living portfolio environment featuring a real-time React Three Fiber Core, full-duplex voice interaction, WebGL shaders, and a dynamic scene-engine architecture.
detailedDescription: NOVA is the cinematic AI operating environment powering this portfolio — the exact system you are interacting with right now. Built with React Three Fiber, WebGL shaders, full-duplex voice interaction via Web Speech API, and deterministic client-side navigation. It demonstrates advanced real-time 3D, particle kinetics, and low-latency voice pipeline engineering.
challenges: Synchronizing 3D neural core particle shaders with full-duplex voice recognition states and responsive audio reactivity at 60fps.
results: Engineered an audio-reactive particle lattice with deterministic client navigation, sub-node attention targeting, and seamless route transitions.

title: FORGE
summary: A local-first AI software engineering platform.
description: Local-first AI software engineering platform and multi-agent execution environment built for high-performance agentic development.
detailedDescription: FORGE is a local-first AI software engineering platform started in July 2026, currently in the architecture stage. It focuses on local model execution, multi-agent orchestration, and developer workflow automation without relying on external cloud dependencies.
challenges: Architecting low-latency local model orchestration and structured agent task scheduling across memory-constrained environments.
results: Currently in architecture phase; foundational runtime contracts and agent coordination specs designed.

title: Petal n Pins
summary: Full-stack e-commerce platform for hair accessories.
description: Full-stack e-commerce platform for hair accessories built with React, Vite, Tailwind, Hono, tRPC, MongoDB Atlas, Razorpay, Cloudinary, and JWT auth. Includes a production-grade security, payments, and performance audit.
detailedDescription: Built in early 2026 in about one month, Petal n Pins is a production full-stack e-commerce solution for hair accessories live at petalnpins.com. Designed with end-to-end type safety via tRPC, fast Hono backend routes, secure Razorpay checkout webhooks, Cloudinary image pipelines, and JWT session handling.
challenges: Ensuring zero-leak payment verification, fast product asset delivery, and sub-100ms API response times on serverless infrastructure.
results: Shipped to production in one month with verified payment signature webhooks, automated order status tracking, and 100% Lighthouse performance score.

title: NOVA Desktop Assistant
summary: Python-powered desktop assistant for automation, math, and computer vision.
description: A Python-powered desktop assistant for app automation, solving math problems, and extracting text from images. A separate, earlier project from the current NOVA portfolio system.
detailedDescription: Developed between August 2024 and January 2025, NOVA Desktop Assistant is a standalone desktop application written in Python. It executes desktop app automation, OCR text extraction from screenshots, and computational problem solving. Note: This is an earlier, distinct desktop project separate from the current NOVA portfolio operating environment.
challenges: Achieving reliable OCR extraction and responsive system automation hooks across multiple display resolutions.
results: Completed desktop automation suite supporting custom keyboard triggers, mathematical OCR evaluation, and automated application launches.
